caption: The drawing depicts a composition featuring a brown bird perched on a branch, with its head facing slightly to the left. The bird is positioned on a thick, horizontal branch that extends from a more gnarled, upward-curving piece of wood. Attached to the lower part of this wood piece is a large, layered fungus or shelf mushroom, colored in various shades of brown and yellow, with distinct ridges and textures. The background is a plain, off-white color without any additional elements or scenery. The artist's signature, "Adolph Beilin," appears in light brown script at the lower left portion of the image.
title: Carved Bird and Nest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
